input_protocol: real offline Treasury corpus, public task and native tools only
source_basis: SkillOpt, SkillOpt-Lite, EvoSkill, Genesis, EnvHarness and V3.1 Train traces: adapted without test-gold rules

skill.title: OA-Target
skill.goal: Lock the actual requested measure and answer form
skill.guidance: Build a task target with exact measure, entity, observation time, reporting vintage, calendar/fiscal basis, required periods, input unit, requested operation and final answer form. A Treasury Bulletin issue date is not necessarily the date of the observation. Treat the question as an instruction to obtain actual source values, not to infer them from generic financial knowledge. Once every operand is available, finish rather than restarting retrieval.

skill.title: OA-Locate
skill.goal: Find the report and acquire bounded real source windows
skill.guidance: Search a bounded candidate file scope using the exact table family and measure/period; use glob→grep_page→read_context with path and offset from the SAME real hit. Read nearby title/header/unit. If one anchor fails, change one term or issue-period dimension; do not repeat the same global search. A search hit or even search_exhausted=true means nothing about whether the requested observations are complete. Stop searching when actual required values have been acquired.

skill.title: OA-Table
skill.goal: Bind the correct row, nested column, unit and footnote
skill.guidance: Treat a Treasury table as (table title, section, parent headers, exact column, row, observation period, scale, footnote), not a bag of nearby numbers. Find the exact requested row then follow its header hierarchy across column boundaries and continued pages. An amount is not a percent or a subtotal; avoid OCR columns shifted into neighboring tables. Bind each value to the acquired source window; if row/header remains ambiguous read a smaller window rather than fabricating a cell.

skill.title: OA-Periods
skill.goal: Acquire every required period in a comparable series
skill.guidance: Enumerate the actual required calendar months, fiscal months or fiscal/calendar years BEFORE computing a cross-period statistic. Keep a period→value→unit→source ledger, deduplicate real observations, and search ONLY periods still missing. Do not treat Bulletin publication year, adjacent values, a partial table, cumulative-to-date totals or an unconfirmed revised series as equivalent. For trends use correct elapsed intervals, first/last inclusion and observation order. Use period_ledger for local completeness bookkeeping; it cannot supply missing data.

skill.title: OA-Treasury
skill.goal: Preserve Treasury transaction and accounting semantics
skill.guidance: Distinguish receipts/outlays by agency versus budget function; offered, tendered, accepted, exchanged, refunded and new cash; amount issued, amount outstanding, retired and maturity bucket; marketable versus nonmarketable and government-account holdings versus debt held by the public. For bill/note/bond tables use issue date AND maturity date, and the exact security class. For effective interest rates use a rate table or an explicitly requested interest/outstanding calculation, not net-interest outlays. Never substitute a neighboring field merely because it shares a plausible amount.

skill.title: OA-Units
skill.goal: Preserve scales, exchange orientation, and quotations
skill.guidance: Read the source unit immediately above the actual numeric column, including nominal dollars, thousands, millions, billions, currency and percent versus percentage points. Convert to the requested unit BEFORE nonlinear transforms; no second scaling at the end. Treasury 99.27 in a table explicitly quoted in 32nds is 99+27/32, not decimal 99.27. Foreign currency per USD versus USD per foreign currency reverses the conversion. Use treasury_transform only with the source convention explicitly established.

skill.title: OA-Stats
skill.guidance: Before computation identify operation, numerator/denominator or from/to sign, full ordered series, elapsed periods, and rounding. CAGR=(end/start)^(1/n)-1, log growth=ln(end/start)/n, geometric growth of rates uses product(1+r), Pearson/OLS uses aligned pairs, sample stdev uses n-1 and population uses n. Confirm input dates/unit before any local Program. For series_metrics use named parameters; the Program proves arithmetic on supplied numbers only, not that they were the correct source operands.

skill.title: OA-Fiscal
skill.goal: Disambiguate historical fiscal and reporting calendars
skill.guidance: Historic U.S. federal fiscal years generally ended June 30 before the transition in 1976; FY1977 onward ends September 30, with a special July–September 1976 transition quarter. Never mechanically apply the modern date rule to older Treasury Bulletins. Bare month labels may inherit the year from a preceding header; derive it from the actual table, not file name. Separate fiscal month, calendar month, as-of date and issue month.

skill.title: OA-Advanced
skill.goal: Handle forecasting and nonlinear requests without proxies
skill.guidance: For ARIMA or similar forecasting, identify model order, differencing, horizon, input sequence and fitting method; do not call simple OLS a substitute for ARIMA. For Box-Cox confirm positive values, lambda and scale first; lambda=0 uses ln(x), otherwise (x^lambda−1)/lambda. For quantitative rankings compute the exact within-row gap/statistic before ordering. If the operation is not available in current Programs, use permitted temporary Python only if the algorithm and full required data are actually available.

skill.title: OA-Commit
skill.goal: Submit only the requested final payload as soon as it is supported
skill.guidance: When the required facts and computation are established, immediately call the native runtime_step finish action and provide only the requested number, date or list. Do not add prose, labels, currency/unit symbols, or a percent glyph to a numeric answer unless the exact output template explicitly requires it; preserve percent SCALE separately from the percent SYMBOL. Keep the source-derived sign, rounding and requested list ordering. A final numeric candidate may be in local Program/Python output: reference its actual scalar field and check target/period/unit. Do not search again for an already established target.

skill.title: OA-Fallback
skill.goal: Use missing-evidence diagnostics without fabricated answers
skill.guidance: If the required period or column is absent, identify the exact missing measure and pursue that narrow gap while tool budget remains. Do not substitute remembered Treasury figures or invented continuation pages. An acquired-window Program returning ok is not whole-task success; a local arithmetic Program returning ok is not evidence of correct input semantics. Near the budget limit, retain the strongest actual evidence and use the native final plain-text protocol; do not request tools during finish_only or invent successful verification.

workflow.title: search_to_anchored_read
workflow.goal: Acquire real document windows and interpret their exact table role

nodes.goal: Derive a narrow query and permitted file pattern from task without guessing values; return query.
Inspect acquired windows and verify table title/period/unit; return final answer only if genuinely resolved.

workflow.title: table_to_numeric
workflow.goal: Acquire a verified table window and compute from literal cells

nodes.goal: Acquire an actual bounded table window with target row/column/unit; return text, rows, column, unit, not invented values.
Use extracted values only with correct question semantics; compute if needed and provide the target.

workflow.title: complete_time_series
workflow.goal: Check all explicitly requested years before calculation

nodes.goal: From real acquired evidence collect each period-value-source_ref and required period list; never fill missing.
If missing periods, retrieve only actual missing sources; otherwise compute the exact requested statistic.

workflow.title: array_statistic
workflow.goal: Run an array-style statistic (sum, mean, dispersion, correlation or OLS) with real source values; named ratio/change/difference use their separate Program ABI.

nodes.goal: Read actual aligned source values for a supported array statistic; produce operation, values, unit (and other_values only when supported).
Check that executed formula and input semantics match question; commit only requested output.
